Quillinox — ADA Title II Compliance Platform for Local Government

ADA Title II Compliance Platform

# The Complete System of Recordfor ADA Title II Compliance

Quillinox scans your entire website for WCAG 2.1 AA violations, remediates PDFs at scale, generates your compliance defense package, manages grievances, and maintains a tamper-evident audit trail — all in one platform.

Request a Demo See How It Works

--- days until the April 24, 2026 deadline

## The Compliance Gap Is Wider Than You Think

Most local governments have hundreds of untagged PDFs on their websites. The federal deadline is approaching fast.

### DOJ Enforcement Is Real

The Department of Justice finalized ADA Title II digital accessibility rules in April 2024. Compliance deadlines are April 24, 2026 for populations of 50,000+ and April 26, 2027 for smaller municipalities.

### Compliance Is More Than PDFs

ADA Title II requires WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for all web content — web pages, PDFs, videos, audio, and documents. Most governments are only thinking about PDFs when the rule covers everything on their website.

### No Single Tool Covers It All

Governments are cobbling together WCAG scanners, PDF remediators, and spreadsheets. Without a unified system, there's no defensible audit trail and no way to prove compliance to the DOJ.

## How Quillinox Works

A fully automated pipeline from discovery to compliance, with a complete audit trail at every step.

#### Scan

Crawl your entire website with axe-core to identify every WCAG 2.1 AA violation, discover PDFs, videos, audio, and documents.

#### Remediate

AI-powered PDF/UA-1 tagging injects structure tags into original documents. Accessible HTML alternatives for complex files.

#### Generate

Auto-generate your compliance defense package: ACR/VPAT, Accessibility Policy, Remediation Roadmap, and Executive Report.

#### Track

Manage accessibility grievances with intake, status tracking, resolution notes, and an embeddable citizen-facing widget.

#### Audit

Every action logged in a tamper-evident cryptographic hash chain. Irrefutable proof of your remediation efforts.

#### Monitor

Real-time compliance dashboard with KPI scores, document status, trend charts, and deadline countdown.

## Built Different. Built for Government.

Quillinox covers the entire compliance lifecycle in one unified platform — from scanning to legal defense.

### Complete System of Record

Other tools solve one piece of the puzzle. Quillinox covers the entire compliance lifecycle — scanning, remediation, documentation, grievance management, and audit trails — in one unified platform with one audit chain.

### Cryptographic Audit Trail

Every action in the pipeline — archive, analyze, tag, validate — is logged with cryptographic hashing in a tamper-evident chain. If you're ever audited by the DOJ, you have irrefutable, timestamped proof of your remediation efforts.

### Compliance Defense Package

When the DOJ comes knocking, you need more than scan results. Quillinox generates all six documents required for legal defense: Executive Report, ACR/VPAT, Accessibility Policy, Remediation Roadmap, Grievance Log, and Exceptions Register — each with cryptographic verification.

### Government-First Design

Built for municipalities, not generic websites. Quillinox understands procurement cycles, CFR citations, population-tier deadlines, and the document types local governments publish. Purpose-built for the public sector.

## Standards We Address

WCAG 2.1 AA

PDF/UA-1

ADA Title II

Section 508

CA SB 707

## Don't Wait for a Complaint. Get Compliant Today.

Every day without a complete compliance system is a day of risk. Let us show you how Quillinox can bring your entire digital presence into compliance.
